symbolic_construction: Native Qt vector stroke outlines, currentColor fills; no raster tracing.
provenance: Original project-authored paths; no upstream paths or app logos imported.

icons.label: Application library
icons.meaning: All applications; not current selection count

icons.label: Recent
icons.meaning: Recently used objects, with no implied replay

icons.label: Workspace
icons.meaning: Nonoverlapping regions belonging to one workspace

icons.label: Window
icons.meaning: Window identity; not automatically a new window action

icons.label: Application
icons.meaning: Generic app fallback; never replaces a known branded application logo

icons.label: No matching objects
icons.meaning: Search has no matches; not an error or proof an object does not exist

icons.label: Back
icons.meaning: Previous logical destination; adapters may mirror for RTL

icons.label: Forward
icons.meaning: Next logical destination; adapters may mirror for RTL

icons.label: Up
icons.meaning: Upward spatial or hierarchical movement; not automatically RTL-mirrored

icons.label: Remove from collection
icons.meaning: Remove membership; distinct from deleting or closing

icons.label: Close
icons.meaning: Close a surface; does not imply canceling underlying work

icons.label: Refresh
icons.meaning: Read/reconcile current information; not blindly retry a command

icons.label: Undo
icons.meaning: Only show when the specific action supports undo

icons.label: Copy
icons.meaning: Copy content or recipe; a new operation keeps explicit new scope

icons.label: Power
icons.meaning: Power action; label must identify its actual consequence

icons.label: Restore view
icons.meaning: Restore view geometry; not a promise of data rollback

icons.label: Sort
icons.meaning: Order controls require explicit key/direction labels

icons.label: Trash
icons.meaning: Destructive delete/trash is not the close action

icons.label: Speaker
icons.meaning: Output device identity, not its current volume level

icons.label: Battery
icons.meaning: Battery capability/polarity; not a charge percentage or charging report

icons.label: Network
icons.meaning: Network/Internet category, not a connection-health reading

icons.label: Music
icons.meaning: Music category; actual notation, not a decorative signal waveform

icons.label: Wireless network
icons.meaning: Wireless capability; never override signal-strength or security-specific status names

icons.label: Bluetooth
icons.meaning: Conventional protocol sign; not an app logo or a claimed universal pictogram

icons.label: Remote desktop
icons.meaning: Two named endpoints still require labels; icon does not identify direction alone

icons.label: Supported success
icons.meaning: Use only when evidence supports the stated success

icons.label: Pending
icons.meaning: Static pending mark; no guarantee of a queued or cancelable operation

icons.label: Offline or disconnected
icons.meaning: Disconnected ends, distinct from a failed command

icons.label: Connected
icons.meaning: A connection observation, not proof of physical output

notes: Symbolic variants append -symbolic to primary IDs and aliases.
Only generic noun/action/protocol signs; no branded app logos.
Quantitative battery/signal/volume and evidence-specific states require live adapters.
